title.en: OLD AGE AND DISABILITY PENSIONS ACT AMENDMENT NO. 1 REGULATIONS 2021

text.en: Regulation 2 of the Old Age and Disability Pensions Regulations. in these Regulations referred to as the principal Regulations, is repealed and the following new regulation is substituted therefor"Interpretation

Regulation 4 of the principal Regulations is amended by adding the following new sub-regulation"(3) An allowance to be called an ·'allowance for the blind" which shall be payable at the rate specified in the Schedule to these Regulations to any person who satisfies the Pensions Officer that(a) he is below the age of 15 years;

(b) he has been certified by a Government Medical Officer or a qualified medical practitioner approved by the Director-General of Medical Services. to be blind; and

(c) either(i) he is a citizen of Brunei Darussalam; or

(ii) he was born in Brunei Darussalam and he has no national status, immediately preceding the date on which he became eligible for such allowance.".
Regulation 7 of the principal Regulations is repealed and the following new regulation is substituted therefor"Allowance in respect of mental disorder

The Schedule to the principal Regulations is repealed and the following new Schedule is substituted therefor"SCHEDULE (regulations 3, 4, 5, 6, 7 and 8)

PENSIONS AND ALLOWANCES Pension or allowance Rate per month l. Old age pension $250

(I) An allowance to be called "allowance for mental disorder" shall, whenever the Pensions Officer is satisfied that there is need for such an allowance. be payable at the rate specified in the Schedule to these Regulations. to any person who satisfies the ·J Pensions Officer that'I

(a) in the case of a person who has attained the age of 15 years(i) he has been certified by a Government Medical Officer or a qualified medical practitioner approved by the Director-General of Medical Services(A) as a person suffering from mental disorder: and

(B) is, under and within the meaning of the provisions of the Mental Health Order, 2014 (S 25/20 14), either detained in a psychiatric facility or delivered over to the care and custody of any relative or friend: and

(ii) has resided in Brunei Darussalam for a period of at least 10 years preceding the date on which he was detained or committed;

(b) in the case of a person who is below the age of 15 years(i) he has been certified by a Government Medical Officer or a qualified medical practitioner approved by the Director-General of Medical Services as a person suffering from mental disorder; and

(ii) either(A) he is a citizen of Brunei Darussalam; or

(B) he was born in Brunei Darussalam and he has no national status, immediately preceding the date on which he became eligible for such allowance.

(2) Whenever the Pensions Officer is satisfied that there exists a need for such allowance, an allowance shall be paid to the dependant of any person in receipt on an allowance for mental disorder under sub-regulation (I ){a). at the rate of specified in the Schedule to those Regulations.".
